data.gender_notes: Cissiee is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Cissiee is derived from the Greek and Latin words 'cissus' and 'pure', respectively. In Greek mythology, Cissus was a nymph who healed wounds, representing grace and purity. In Christian tradition, this name signifies the spiritual purity and grace granted by God. The name Cissiee carries the meaning “Graceful, Pure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cissiee usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's divine grace and purity.
data.etymology: Cissiee belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cissiee total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
